philosophy.title: Our Philosophy | Web Design, Visual Identity, and Digital Presence
philosophy.intro: We don't create isolated pieces; we build brands as cohesive systems.
philosophy.body1: At Vhetra, we bring together technology, design, and strategy to turn ideas into living identities. A brand is not defined by a single element, but by the relationship between all of them: its digital architecture, visual identity, and online presence.
philosophy.body2: We create web design and digital presence for brands, projects, and businesses that want to communicate with clarity and consistency. We build fast, accessible websites that work beautifully on every device, combining Next.js, React, and modern technologies with thoughtful design direction.
philosophy.body3: We don't chase short-lived trends; we design structures with identity, built to work and made to last.
philosophy.body4: We are structure and sensitivity at once: code that breathes brand.

services.presenciaDigitalMini: A website paired with a cohesive visual identity
services.presenciaDigitalFull:
A website paired with a clear visual identity, so your brand can communicate professionally across the web and social media. Created for businesses and projects that need a consistent presence across every digital channel.

Includes:

  • Landing page (A simple website to present your business and receive inquiries)
  • Adaptation of an existing logo
  • Typography selection (The fonts your brand will use)
  • Color palette (The colors that will visually represent your brand)
  • Basic visual kit (Graphic elements to keep your aesthetic consistent)
  • Social media identity adaptation
  • 6 initial Instagram posts (Ready-to-publish designed pieces)


Available with monthly maintenance, which may include new posts each month.
services.marcaDigitalFull:
A complete visual system paired with a website developed around your business's specific needs. Ideal for brands that need more than a basic informational site.

Includes:

  • Custom website development (May include appointments, service catalogs, bookings, or other features)
  • Branding (Logo design or redesign and brand visual style)
  • Typography and color definition
  • Social media adaptation
  • 6 initial posts
  • Graphic pieces for digital communication


Available as an ongoing monthly service that may include:

  • Website maintenance
  • Content updates
  • Post management
  • New monthly graphic pieces
services.presenciaEnRedesFull:
A visual and strategic foundation to help your brand communicate professionally on social media. Ideal for businesses or projects launching their Instagram presence with a clear identity, cohesive content, and an initial plan that makes it easier to stay active.

Includes:

  • 30 edited photos (Optimized for social media, with attention to color, framing, and visual style)
  • 9 initial feed posts (Designed around the brand's visual identity to create an attractive, cohesive profile from the start)
  • One-month content calendar (Post ideas and topics planned to keep communication organized and consistent)
  • Existing logo adaptation (If needed, so it works properly on social media)
services.landingPageFull: A simple one-page website that presents your business, services, products, and contact options.

acrodata.titulo: A digital experience designed to move with the body.
acrodata.descripcionP1: We developed an interactive platform centered around a digital library of Acroyoga cards and a tool for creating custom sequences.
acrodata.descripcionP2: At the core of the project is a system that lets users explore dozens of poses through difficulty filters, opening individual cards with a photo, name, and detailed description of each figure. We also developed a game-like feature that generates random cards so users can select them, rearrange them, and intuitively build their own practice flows.
acrodata.descripcionP3: The platform also includes informational sections about classes, educational material, and resources for people who want to get started or deepen their practice, all within a clear, fluid browsing experience optimized for mobile devices.
acrodata.descripcionP4: The main challenge was transforming a collection of educational content into an interactive tool that combines exploration, learning, and play within a single digital experience.

estacionAlemania.titulo: A digital experience for discovering the history and flavors of Estación Alemania.
estacionAlemania.descripcionP1: We developed a digital menu that allows visitors to explore the venue's food and drink offering quickly, clearly, and intuitively from any device.
estacionAlemania.descripcionP2: The site's structure was planned to optimize the user experience, making the full menu easy to access in both Spanish and English, a particularly useful feature for welcoming tourists and local visitors alike. Direct links to social media, contact options, and location details were also included to make interaction and arrival at the venue easier.
estacionAlemania.descripcionP3: As a complement to the digital menu, the platform includes informational content about the history of the former railway station and the Interpretation Center that operates in the same space, organizing the information clearly and accessibly without disrupting the browsing experience.
estacionAlemania.descripcionP4: The result is a digital tool that is easy to manage, optimized for mobile devices, and designed to improve the experience of everyone who visits the venue.

laboragro.titulo: A corporate platform for technical agricultural analysis services.
laboragro.descripcionP1: We developed a corporate web platform designed to present technical agricultural analysis services clearly, professionally, and accessibly for different types of users.
laboragro.descripcionP2: The site's structure was designed to organize a large amount of technical information without compromising the browsing experience. Through a carefully planned content architecture, visitors can quickly access the different analysis services, learn about the laboratory's certifications, and find relevant information about processes, quality standards, and sampling.
laboragro.descripcionP3: The project prioritized visual clarity and easy access to information, turning complex content into an intuitive, well-organized experience. Navigation was also optimized for mobile devices, and multiple contact points were incorporated to make communication with potential clients easier.
laboragro.descripcionP4: The result is a solid institutional platform designed to convey trust, professionalism, and technical credibility, aligned with the laboratory's track record and specialization.

chaUsandivaras.titulo: A clear, simple real estate platform aligned with the brand's identity.
chaUsandivaras.descripcionP1: We developed a real estate platform focused on simplicity, clarity, and ease of use, adapting every design decision to the client's visual identity and specific needs.
chaUsandivaras.descripcionP2: The project was built with a responsive approach, ensuring a consistent and comfortable experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. The interface prioritizes intuitive navigation, allowing users to explore properties quickly and easily while reducing friction and making the most relevant information easy to access.
chaUsandivaras.descripcionP3: The platform includes a filtering system to speed up the property search, helping users find listings according to different criteria efficiently. We also developed a clear and accessible contact section to encourage direct communication between potential clients and the real estate agency.
chaUsandivaras.descripcionP4: The result is an elegant, functional digital tool designed to provide a simple, fluid experience aligned with the business's commercial goals.

flavia.titulo: A modern digital menu built for simplicity and quick access.
flavia.descripcionP1: We developed a modern digital menu focused on simplicity, quick access, and a clean browsing experience from any device.
flavia.descripcionP2: The project was designed around a clear client requirement: remove unnecessary elements and prioritize only the essential information. The interface uses a minimalist, intuitive structure that lets users explore the menu naturally, without distractions or visual overload, making it comfortable to read on both mobile and desktop devices.
flavia.descripcionP3: To add identity without compromising the overall simplicity, we incorporated a 3D animation created in Blender and integrated it subtly into the experience. This element brings personality to the site while preserving the clean, elegant aesthetic that guided the entire project.
flavia.descripcionP4: The result is a responsive, fast, and visually balanced platform where design and functionality work together to highlight the food offering clearly and directly.

lozzaStudio.titulo: An end-to-end web platform for selling, content management, and user administration.
lozzaStudio.descripcionP1: We developed an end-to-end web platform that brings e-commerce, content management, and user administration together in a single digital solution.
lozzaStudio.descripcionP2: The project was designed with close attention to the user experience, prioritizing clear, intuitive navigation so visitors can find information, reserve a spot in workshops, request custom ceramic pieces, or make purchases quickly and easily. Every section was planned and structured around UX principles to improve conversion and make the site journey feel effortless.
lozzaStudio.descripcionP3: Beyond the public-facing experience, we developed an admin dashboard that allows products, orders, content, and users to be managed without technical knowledge, giving the studio autonomy and flexibility to keep the platform up to date.
lozzaStudio.descripcionP4: The online store is integrated with Mercado Pago to process payments securely, while user authentication and the database support advanced features and efficient management of all site information.

filiSuites.titulo: A visual identity designed to live in the digital space
filiSuites.descripcionP1: For Fili Suites, we worked on the visual identity for social media and the Instagram content strategy, creating a cohesive aesthetic inspired by the colors, textures, and atmosphere of the space.
filiSuites.descripcionP2: The communication is designed to reflect the calm and warmth of the accommodation, building a clear, professional online presence aligned with the guest experience.
